comment: CAIRNWOLD's own ground scatter, in place of Ashen Hollow's. The rules are read from here rather than the shipped file
because the densities are keyed by the GROUND'S OWN MATERIAL - and a second region's ground is made of different stuff.
Without this file the region scatters nothing at all, however many models it has shipped, because not one of its ground
materials appears in the shipped rules' per_m2 tables.
Every kind names a real Cairnwold model rather than a procedural mesh: these were built from CC0 sources at 4K and are
the region's own. Densities are per square metre, blended across cell borders.
The ground materials are the ones the region's four cells wear (bindings.json terrain map): cw_moor_grass on the dry rise,
cw_forest_floor on the birch flank, cw_heather over the south cliff-foot, cw_mud_wet on the wet shelf that drains to the gorge.

NOTE: a tall_tussocks kind was written and placed ZERO instances with no problem reported and no explanation found in the time available. It was removed rather than left in the file looking like it works. The size spread and the third patch scale on moor_grass are the changes that landed.

SHADOWS (2026-10-15, the owner's grass-shadow blink): grass and every wind-driven plant receive shadows but cast none - a swaying blade or frond in the sun's shadow map blinks as it crosses the map's texels. Casting them was also most of the frame: at High the sun's cascades took 24 of the Cairnwold village's 49 ms of GPU (470 M primitives a frame); without them, 3 of 26 ms (82 M). What casts is still (stones, gravel, bark, rocks, the sapling stand) and says far_shadows, so its shadow holds on every level instead of switching off at the third. fade_m is multiplied by the tier's reach (RenderTiers.GroundReach) and the outer 40 % of it thins plant by plant.

heather.note: Heather. REBUILT FROM SCRATCH as a POOL of four generated forms - the previous asset was cw_heather_clump, 384 triangles of intersecting alpha planes 1.1 m across and 0.42 m tall, which renders alone as a squashed pancake of flatted cards with a hole through the middle. Several thousand of those on the moor is what made the meadow read as brown splats lying on the grass. They are now real geometry - fine woody stems that branch twice and carry a flower spike - at 2640-3395 triangles with three LOD levels each, from tools/asset_pipeline/_procgen_heather.py. Sized up from 0.5-0.8 to 0.7-1.25 because the generated clumps are 0.52-1.0 m across and Fitting will not rescale. WIND IS ON and always was: this entry never carried a wind key, so Wind defaulted true and the note claiming 'WIND OFF - woody, it does not sway' described something the data did not do. Heather does move in wind; stiffness 0.95 keeps it to the tips.

The region's own boneleaf kind is keyed to a ground this region's scatter never sees (the four middle cells), so it places none; this one follows the strangeness field instead. Poly Haven shrub (CC0), bleached by the shader.

nightlace.note: Otherworld concept 2026-10-16: NIGHTLACE (canon WORLD_MATERIALS 4: night-flowering), Poly Haven celandine (CC0) with its green turned toward blue, its pale parts glowing blue after dark, in drifts on the moor and round the Foldscar - the moss lights of Cairnwold's lore.

otherworld.note: Where the world is strange (Greybox/Otherworld.cs, --visual otherworld=off|subtle|bold). Calm round the two villages (Ashen Hollow's waystation, Cairnwold's green), rising over the open ground from 45 to 170 m out, strangest at the Foldscar's heart (rock_foldscar_heart) and fading to nothing 160 m from it. 'If everything is strange, the Other stops feeling Other.'
